title: Build with Confidence
introduction: Automated tests and version control make change visible, repeatable and reversible.
learningOutcomes: Plan an intermediate project in small verified increments.

activities.question: Order the common parts of a focused test.
activities.explanation: A focused test arranges its context, acts once, then asserts an observable result.

activities.question: What should a useful commit usually contain?
options: One coherent change with a descriptive message
Every unrelated edit from the month
activities.explanation: Small coherent commits are easier to review, understand and reverse.

activities.question: Tests should include important boundary and failure cases as well as normal cases.
activities.explanation: Boundaries and expected failures often reveal assumptions that happy-path examples miss.
